answer_line: Each generated image is a single solid white, upward‑pointing, roughly equilateral triangle on a black background: a point near the top (row 1–3, somewhere in columns 3–8), two straight sides sloping down at about 30° from vertical (≈ ½ column per row), and a flat horizontal base somewhere in rows 6–11 spanning up to columns 1–10. Size varies from about 5 to 9 rows high (base 5–10 pixels wide) and position shifts left/right and up/down, but the triangle never touches the outer one‑pixel frame. Interior is filled white, outside is black.
